_readme: THE MODEL'S ENTRY — locked, versioned, committed. Never regenerated at build time:
the whole point is that these picks were fixed before kickoff, like everyone else's.
Derived from Can-Tre-Beat-Vegas's committed preseason futures snapshot
(web/public/data/nfl/latest.json), read at 0-0 across the league with all 272
regular-season games still to play. No new simulation was run for this pool.
`abstentions` is deliberate and is rendered as such. Where the Elo has no signal the
model takes the zero rather than inventing a confident answer.
To lock a future season: bump `version`, write a new file, leave this one alone.
